description: Record that you appealed Trustpilot's kept-online decision through its appeal form. The case returns to awaiting_tp until Trustpilot's answer is recorded as its next decision (record_decision). Refused for a second appeal and more than six months after the decision. ref, optional, is Trustpilot's case or ticket number for the appeal (letters, digits and . _ : # / -, no spaces), never a note. business_facts, optional, are the facts the appeal carried, as you passed them to appeal_packet: they are kept with the case (until the reviewer is erased), and for a Defamation report they record who stated that the accusation is untrue. (capability: cases.mark_filed_own)
name: record_appeal
